name: Power Amplifier - Guard
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Guard capability.

61011.name: Power Boost III · Guard
61011.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
When performing Guard, Crit RES <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit DMG RES <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
